mapper.sql: select n.notice_id as "noticeId", n.title as "title", n.content as "content", n.publish_start_date as "publishStartDate", n.publish_end_date as "publishEndDate", n.important_yn as "importantYn", n.status as "status", n.updated_at as "updatedAt", n.updated_by as "updatedBy" from notices n

where.if: n.status = 'ACTIVE' and CURRENT_DATE between n.publish_start_date and n.publish_end_date
and exists ( select 1 from notice_targets role_target where role_target.notice_id = n.notice_id and role_target.target_type = 'ROLE' and role_target.target_id = #{criteria.targetRoleCode} )

and exists ( with recursive ancestors(organization_code) as ( select #{criteria.targetOrganizationCode} union all select rel.parent_organization_code from organization_relations rel join ancestors a on a.organization_code = rel.organization_code where rel.status = 'ACTIVE' and (rel.effective_end_date is null or rel.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ) select 1 from notice_targets org_target join ancestors a on a.organization_code = org_target.target_id where org_target.notice_id = n.notice_id and org_target.target_type = 'ORGANIZATION' )

mapper.select: order by n.important_yn desc, n.publish_start_date desc, n.notice_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select n.notice_id as "noticeId", n.title as "title", n.content as "content", n.publish_start_date as "publishStartDate", n.publish_end_date as "publishEndDate", n.important_yn as "importantYn", n.status as "status", n.created_at as "createdAt", n.created_by as "createdBy", n.updated_at as "updatedAt", n.updated_by as "updatedBy" from notices n where n.notice_id = #{noticeId} and n.status != 'DELETED'
mapper.insert: insert into notices (notice_id, title, content, publish_start_date, publish_end_date, important_yn, created_by, updated_by, change_reason) values (#{noticeId}, #{request.title}, #{request.content}, #{request.publishStartDate}, #{request.publishEndDate}, #{request.importantYn}, #{userId}, #{userId}, #{request.changeReason})
mapper.update: update notices set title = #{request.title}, content = #{request.content}, publish_start_date = #{request.publishStartDate}, publish_end_date = #{request.publishEndDate}, important_yn = #{request.importantYn}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId}, change_reason = #{request.changeReason} where notice_id = #{noticeId} and status != 'DELETED'
mapper.insert: insert into notice_targets (notice_id, target_type, target_id, created_by) values (#{noticeId}, #{target.targetType}, #{target.targetId}, #{userId})

insert into notice_attachments (notice_id, original_file_name, stored_file_name, content_type, file_size, file_content, created_by) values (#{noticeId}, #{originalFileName}, #{storedFileName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{fileContent}, #{userId})
mapper.select: select nt.notice_target_id as "noticeTargetId", nt.notice_id as "noticeId", nt.target_type as "targetType", nt.target_id as "targetIdValue", coalesce(r.role_name, o.organization_name, nt.target_id) as "targetName" from notice_targets nt left join roles r on nt.target_type = 'ROLE' and r.role_code = nt.target_id left join organizations o on nt.target_type = 'ORGANIZATION' and o.organization_code = nt.target_id where nt.notice_id = #{noticeId} order by nt.target_type, nt.target_id

select attachment_id as "attachmentId", notice_id as "noticeId", original_file_name as "originalFileName", file_size as "fileSize", created_at as "createdAt", created_by as "createdBy" from notice_attachments where notice_id = #{noticeId} order by attachment_id
